subject: Access mapping & attribute ownership request for CAIQ/SIG
messages:
From: Helen Park <helen.park@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access mapping & attribute ownership request for CAIQ/SIG

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need to collect a compact set of artifacts showing how Redwood maps identity attributes from SAML/SSO to the application roles and how ownership is assigned for those roles (SCIM-backed provisioning where applicable). Specifically we are looking for:

- SAML assertion samples (NameID formats, attribute names used, example Role attributes)
- SCIM attribute mapping (which SCIM attributes map to which app fields; show examples)
- Role ownership matrix (who owns each role/group in your system)
- Minimal justification for least-privilege decisions for service accounts and elevated roles
- Retention policy for authn/authz logs and sample assertion retention timestamps

We appreciate redacted samples where needed. Can Redwood provide these artifacts and a proposed delivery timeline? Our audit window closes in two weeks (by 2027-09-13) so a two-week turnaround would be ideal.

Also please let us know if any of these items will need an NDA or special redaction process.

Best,
Helen Park
Security Operations
NovaHealth Systems

[signature: Helen Park | Security Operations | NovaHealth Systems]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access mapping & attribute ownership request for CAIQ/SIG

Hi Helen — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (security compliance lead) and Sean (identity infra) to coordinate artifacts and redaction.

Plan (high level):
- We can provide redacted SAML assertion samples and a short explanation of NameID formats in the next 3 business days.
- SCIM attribute map: provide CSV with mapping and a short note on default vs. overwritten attributes (attached: attribute_map_v1.csv).
- Role ownership matrix: attached draft (role_ownership_matrix.xlsx) — we will fill owners for any roles you flag as material.
- Least-privilege rationale: short writeup per service account (we'll include examples inline in the role matrix).
- Retention: authn/authz logs are retained 13 months by default; we will include log retention policy and a sample assertion timestamp export (we can provide redacted timestamps, not full PII).

If you confirm the two-week deadline (by 2027-09-13) we'll prioritize the rest of the artifacts and schedule a short handoff call if you want to walk through the matrices.

Attachments included:
- attribute_map_v1.csv (SCIM attribute -> app field mapping)
- role_ownership_matrix.xlsx (draft)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: attribute_map_v1.csv, role_ownership_matrix.xlsx]

From: Helen Park <helen.park@novahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, security_ops@novahealth.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access mapping & attribute ownership request for CAIQ/SIG

Karthik/Laura/Sean — that timeline works. Two quick clarifications:

1) For the role ownership matrix, can you mark which owners are "process owners" (policy-level) vs "technical owners" (hands-on access)? We need that distinction for the SIG mapping.
2) For retention, can you include the retention start point (assertion received timestamp vs token issuance) and whether any logs are archived offsite after 90 days?

We do not need an NDA for redacted samples. If you can provide the SAML samples and the CSV by EOD Friday (2027-09-03) that would be great and we'll review for any follow-ups.

Thanks — Helen

[signature: Helen Park | NovaHealth Systems]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access mapping & attribute ownership request for CAIQ/SIG

Helen — attaching the SAML assertion samples and a SCIM delta example. Quick notes inline:

- Role ownership: in the attached matrix we mark "policy owner" vs "technical owner" in column G. Where roles are managed by an external IdP, the policy owner is our Product Security lead and the technical owner is the Identity team (Sean).
- Retention: authn/assertion logs use "assertion_received_ts" as the retention start. Logs are kept on hot storage for 90 days, then archived to encrypted object storage (retained 13 months total). We included a short export showing redacted timestamps (saml_assertion_samples.pdf).
- SCIM delta sample: scim_delta_sample.json shows a mock provisioning event where external IdP sets displayName and department; we included mapping comments.

Attachments attached: saml_assertion_samples.pdf, scim_delta_sample.json (redacted), updated role_ownership_matrix.xlsx (now with process/technical owner columns).

If you'd like a walkthrough, we can do a 30-min session next week — propose Tue 2027-09-07 10:00 PDT.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: saml_assertion_samples.pdf, scim_delta_sample.json, role_ownership_matrix.xlsx (updated)]
